component.name: LivePlayer
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.overlay = m.top.findNode("overlay") m.channelName = m.top.findNode("channelName") m.videoTitle = m.top.findNode("videoTitle") m.errorLabel = m.top.findNode("errorLabel") m.hideTimer = m.top.findNode("hideOverlay") m.hideTimer.observeField("fire", "onHideOverlay") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") end sub
sub onChannelSet() ch = m.top.channel m.channelName.text = ch.name showAndScheduleHide() playCurrentSlot() end sub
sub playCurrentSlot() ch = m.top.channel nowUtc = getUtcSeconds() slot = getCurrentVideo(ch, nowUtc) if slot = invalid m.errorLabel.text = "No video scheduled right now." return end if
m.currentSeek = slot.seek m.videoTitle.text = slot.video.title
' Resolve URL (may hit backend for YouTube stream URL) url = resolvePlayableUrl(slot.video, m.top.backendBase) if Len(url) = 0 m.errorLabel.text = "Could not play this video. Skipping..." skipToNext() return end if
m.errorLabel.text = "" content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.title = slot.video.title content.url = url content.streamFormat = detectFormat(url)
m.video.content = content m.video.seekMode = "accurate" m.video.seek = slot.seek m.video.control = "play" end sub
function detectFormat(url as String) as String u = LCase(url) if Instr(1, u, ".m3u8") > 0 then return "hls" if Instr(1, u, ".mpd") > 0 then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
sub onVideoState() s = m.video.state if s = "finished" playCurrentSlot() ' next slot else if s = "error" m.errorLabel.text = "Playback error. Skipping..." skipToNext() end if end sub
sub skipToNext() ' Simple skip: recompute slot after a short delay timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") timer.duration = 2 timer.observeField("fire", "playCurrentSlot") m.top.appendChild(timer) timer.control = "start" end sub
sub showAndScheduleHide() m.overlay.visible = true m.hideTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onHideOverlay() m.overlay.visible = false end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key = "options" m.video.control = "stop" m.top.closed = true return true end if if key = "up" or key = "down" showAndScheduleHide() return true end if if key = "OK" or key = "play" showAndScheduleHide() return true end if return false end function
